steps.content: The scene behind the door is even more dramatic than you pictured.
It's an alchemy workshop so vast it borders on the absurd. At its center stands a pot half a story tall, furnace fires roaring beneath it while pipes and channels spread outward like arteries.
A gigantic alchemy cauldron stands there, brandishing metal tongs and a long-handled ladle, muttering under its breath.

steps.speaker: Alchemy Cauldron
steps.content: The end of equivalent exchange... is the leap beyond equivalence!

steps.speaker: Alchemy Cauldron
steps.content: Heh heh heh... just one more step. One more.
It opens its mouth, and the rows of teeth inside shake in unison with the ladle perched on its head.

steps.speaker: Alchemy Cauldron
steps.content: Oh? New witnesses?
Until it spots the coin bank on the other side.

steps.speaker: Alchemy Cauldron
steps.content: No, wait, you're here to steal my life's work!

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: That shiny's mine, meow!
The metal tongs in the old cauldron's grip lift. Clasped firmly between their tips is a gold coin gleaming with an unnatural luster.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Put that down.

steps.speaker: Alchemy Cauldron
steps.content: Put it down? Bahahaha!

steps.speaker: Alchemy Cauldron
steps.content: This is the key to unlocking the deepest truths! The essential ingredient to make the impossible possible! And you expect me to just hand it over?!
You frown, unsure what this oversized pot is trying to say. But one thing is certain: it's dead set on fighting you for that gold coin.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Murphy, get ready. Make that gold coin drop from the tongs.
The shackles flare to life just as Murphy activates her ability.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: You're gonna... hold that gold coin <color=#fb9259>steady</color> for sure!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Now!

The gold coin drops in an instant, but the old cauldron moves with impossible speed. With an eerie cackle, it flings the coin high into the air, then flicks its ladle upward, sending the coin soaring straight toward the pot's mouth.

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: You absolute ******** of a cauldron, meow! Give me back my shiny!!!
The flames rage violently, and the surrounding light thickens into a syrupy crimson.

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: I'll take you down myself, meow!!
With a furious roar, it rolls forward in a flash of golden light, faster than ever before.
Then, the very next second—

The workshop floor, already slick with molten gold and alchemical residue, betrays it. Rolling with too much momentum, the coin bank loses all grip, spinning out of control and skidding sideways like a bowling ball.

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: Meowwww!
With a thunderous crash, the coin bank slams headfirst into the workshop's side wall.
The gold coin has already reached the pot's edge, but the sudden impact throws it off course.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Lynn! Your turn!
Lynn nods and sprints forward. The moment her fingers touch the gold coin, you activate the shackles, pulling her straight back to your side.
There's no time to celebrate. You activate the shackles again immediately, purging the residual misfortune from the coin.
Conventional communications can't reach the Bureau, so you're left with the crudest method possible to tell the team above ground to begin the external experiment and restore the facility.
You take out the analyzer Norma gave you, the same model stationed on the Bureau's surface level. You crank its reception power to maximum, then touch it with your shackles, setting off the alarm.

steps.speaker: Analyzer
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>—! Warning, parameter overflow!</color>
After several alarm blares, white light engulfs everything. You hear machinery roaring back to life from the dome above. The alchemy cauldron before you immediately senses something is wrong.

steps.speaker: Alchemy Cauldron
steps.content: Damn it... DAMN IT! I was so close... SO CLOSE! I refuse to accept this!
The alchemy cauldron before you leaps high into the air, then comes crashing down with colossal force.
The entire workshop lets out a sickening screech, like steel beams being wrenched apart, and then the center of the floor suddenly caves in.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Everyone, move! The floor's going!
Crucible stands, platforms, red-hot metal plates, and everyone too slow to brace themselves all plunge downward together.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: ...Ahhh!
Weightlessness hits without warning, and you plummet through a chaos of roaring noise and blistering heat.
